connected_surface_reason: One required Y124/Y132/Y134/Y140/Y142 provider-to-sync integration boundary: literal path construction, account-wide change feed, same-account state identity import and durable reversible replacement. Guards/backup/checkpoint semantics cannot be split away safely.
preview_grant: Only pending merge protection before planning/index/convergence and preserve Root-added preview_with(...,RunSettings) for existing Y148 job owner truth. No UI edits. Also same identity migration under existing PairLock before replica::identify; no owner relabeling or new UI behavior. Also protect pending durable ReplacementIntent relatives beside pending merge relatives through the same protect_pending boundary before planning, indexing, convergence or single apply. Read-only intent lookup validates lock/key/endpoints; preview/single must not mutate or clear recovery.
single_grant: Only reject pending durable merge original/KeepBoth siblings under already held PairLock before stage/apply. Preserve recorded state, checkpoint, backups and unrelated single-action behavior. Also protect pending durable ReplacementIntent relatives beside pending merge relatives through the same protect_pending boundary before planning, indexing, convergence or single apply. Read-only intent lookup validates lock/key/endpoints; preview/single must not mutate or clear recovery.
orchestration_full_grant: Only pending merge protection before full index/convergence; preserve omitted paths and checkpoint semantics. Also protect pending durable ReplacementIntent relatives beside pending merge relatives through the same protect_pending boundary before planning, indexing, convergence or single apply. Read-only intent lookup validates lock/key/endpoints; preview/single must not mutate or clear recovery.
duplicate_plan_grant: Only remaining literal path metadata/hash observations and pending merge omissions; preserve dedupe counts and repeated apply identity guard.
identity_versions_grant: Only verified same-account identity aliases for old version pair/backend/lock read and restore; no changes to version retention/ordinary serialization/backup semantics.
engine_feed_grant: Cohesive account-feed ancestry and bootstrap integration from incremental_collect; unknown parent Rebuild, foreign-root ignore, no unproven deletion/duplicate collapse.
apply_transaction_binding_grant: Only pass typed RunVersions/VersionSide pair/lock/owner/root/relative identity into Staged before reversible provider fallback. No global or inferred context; preserve backup/transaction semantics.
merge_stage_binding_grant: Only pass existing Versions/StateKey/VersionSide identity into outstanding original-side Stage before existing publish; preserve all original checks, backup ordering, partial recovery and create-only sibling behavior.
version_save_grant: Only replica marker path formation through sync_child_path, preserving existing identity and archive/copy/backup semantics.
replacement_publish_grant: Extract only the current Staged publication/verification and the new NoReplace Intent branch into one cohesive helper below the formatted size limit. Staged::publish remains a compatible delegating wrapper; no additional behavior or scope.
restore_backup_binding_grant: In version_restore::transfer only: use existing Preserved.signature (when !moved) as typed destination_expected content evidence after successful AppData backup, instead of freshly synthesized hash:0. Preserve all backup, retention, restore and bind ordering.
